summary: Preserve one searchable embedded Kie standard Market task-model catalog and one direct generic Market video shortcut under the existing media extension. The catalog is built from Kie's llms.txt index and every linked English page that documents the shared createTask contract; each record carries its official page URL. The shortcut defaults to the documented Wan 2.7 T2V contract and allows another model only with its caller-supplied documented input JSON.
reason: The generated generic Market create/query commands cover the shared task API but do not give CLI users a searchable, sourced task-model catalog or a compact Wan T2V request form. Market Chat and Omni pages use other endpoint shapes and remain generated routes, not catalog rows. The refresh reads the documented contract ID instead of trusting a stale schema enum, rejects missing page contracts, duplicate IDs, and title/contract conflicts, and exposes a bounded embedded snapshot rather than a live global registry. Adding commands under the existing local media namespace avoids a generated or hand-written top-level command per model family and does not validate arbitrary model inputs.
validated_outcome: Focused Go catalog, Wan validation, video shortcut, task polling, and result URL tests; go build ./cmd/kie-pp-cli; Python catalog consistency tests; catalog uniqueness and required-ID checks; and git diff --check pass. The snapshot includes the required Seedream 5 Pro layer decomposition, all four Qwen3 image task models, and Kling V2.5 Turbo image-to-video under their documented IDs.
